title: Can't launch game from command line without .godot folder
body:
### Tested versions

- Tested v4.4.1.stable.official [49a5bc7b6]
- Tested v4.5.beta1.official [46c495ca2]

### System information

Godot v4.5.beta1 - Manjaro Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Fri, 09 May 2025 10:53:27 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Mesa Intel(R) UHD Graphics 620 (KBL GT2) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-8350U CPU @ 1.70GHz (8 threads) - 15.36 GiB memory

### Issue description

Trying to launch the game directly (without opening the editor first) results in a dialog with the message:
`Couldn't detect whether to run the editor, the project manager or a specific project. Aborting.`
Opening the editor once fixes this problem.

This appears to be caused by a missing `.godot` folder. The `.godot` project folder is in the `.gitignore` file, so it doesn't exist on fresh Git repository checkouts (which is how I ran into this problem).

The following error appears in the terminal:
```
ERROR: Unrecognized UID: "uid://b88g1f54b35hc".
   at: get_id_path (core/io/resource_uid.cpp:199)
```


### Steps to reproduce

- Create a new project.
- Create a new scene and save it.
- Set the new scene as Main Scene.
- Close the Godot editor.
- Delete the `.godot` folder from the project files to simulate a fresh Git checkout.
- Run Godot from the command line, giving it the new project path: `./Godot_v4.5-beta1_linux.x86_64 .` to launch the game without the editor.

Expected: The Godot game launches the main scene.

Actual: 
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5908a7f0-e846-444a-a7f4-de1972b460a8)
The following errors are printed to the terminal:
```
dragonaxe at Satellite-L in ~/1_prog/godot/games/active/cli-launch-bug-test
$ ../../../versions/Godot_v4.5-beta1_linux.x86_64 .
Godot Engine v4.5.beta1.official.46c495ca2 - https://godotengine.org
glx: failed to create dri3 screen
failed to load driver: nouveau
OpenGL API 4.6 (Core Profile) Mesa 25.0.5-arch1.1 - Compatibility - Using Device: Intel - Mesa Intel(R) UHD Graphics 620 (KBL GT2)

ERROR: Unrecognized UID: "uid://b88g1f54b35hc".
   at: get_id_path (core/io/resource_uid.cpp:199)

(zenity:333063): Gtk-WARNING **: 21:23:39.072: Unknown key gtk-modules in /home/dragonaxe/.config/gtk-4.0/settings.ini

(zenity:333063): Adwaita-WARNING **: 21:23:39.238: Using GtkSettings:gtk-application-prefer-dark-theme with libadwaita is unsupported. Please use AdwStyleManager:color-scheme instead.
ERROR: Couldn't detect whether to run the editor, the project manager or a specific project. Aborting.
   at: start (main/main.cpp:4118)
FAIL: 1
```
